# Tokenizer Refactoring: Token Location Field Migration

## Summary
Successfully refactored all Token creation statements in `/tmp/zig-compiler-project/impl/src/tokenizer.zig` from old field-based format to new structured `.loc` field format.

**Float token:**
```zig
// BEFORE
return Token{
    .tag = .float,
    .start = start,
    .end = self.pos,
    .line = self.line,
    .column = start_column,
};

// AFTER
return Token{
    .tag = .float,
    .loc = .{ .line = self.line, .column = start_column, .start = start, .end = self.pos },
};
```

- `!=` (bang_equal)
- `!` (bang)
- `<=` (less_equal)
- `<<` (lshift)
- `<` (less)
- `>=` (greater_equal)
- `>>` (rshift)
- `>` (greater)

- `:` (colon)
- Single-char operators

EOF token was already using `.loc` format, no changes needed.

- **File Size:** 465 → 446 lines (-19 lines, ~4% reduction)

- **Functions Modified:** 5 (scanNumber, scanString, scanCharLiteral, scanIdentifier, scanOperator)

✅ No syntax errors in refactored code
✅ Backward compatible with existing Token.lexeme() method
